items.title: Byron Stripling interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 25, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: so you can sing that new song “And I Will Always Love You” Whitney Houston you know?

ctx.x: A little sharp is better, or it would really be a downer. There’s that, then the other things, I’ll go through a week of what I do. And I’ll say okay, now I want you to write down all the things you could do as a musician. Shows, club dates, weddings, this, that, boom, boom, boom. Make that list. Then draw a line, and write on the other side the specific skills you will need to do those specific things. What will you need to be a club date musician? Do you have to learn tunes? Do you have to learn “Feelings?” Do…
Wow. I don’t remember that one.
